## Three fixes for things v1.5.8 claimed to have fixed

**The scanlines and pixel grid actually appear now.** The overlay's own
positioning rule had been deleted by an editing mistake, leaving an empty
zero-height element with nowhere to draw. Every setting was working; there
was simply no surface to paint on.

**The emulator is running this firmware.** It was still running v1.5.7's —
the WebAssembly build is a committed artifact that does not rebuild on a
tag, and v1.5.8 shipped without it being refreshed. So Squachy's outline
fix from last release was in the firmware but not in the thing you were
looking at.

**Squachy's crown spikes are outlined.** They rise above the head's own
keyline, so they were the one part of his silhouette still left bare.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: the emulator's LCD scanline and pixel-grid overlays never rendered
- **Fixed**: the emulator shipped stale, running the previous release's firmware
- **Added**: keyline on the crown spikes
